value.rationale: Provides a complete all-order integral homology classification of a canonical graph family, with explicit independent adjacent-degree ranks and a geometric collapse of its Alexander dual; establishes non-shellability uniformly and extends the single-known cube case beyond its scope. The calculations are natural graph-topology invariants rather than arbitrary special parameters.
